item.name: Starter Village / Farm
item.notableAnimals: Chicken, Butterfly, Dragonfly, Armadillo, Wormy, Cow, Goat, Pig, Sheep, Rabbit, Cat
item.progressionUse: First income route for filling early pens before buying paid areas.

item.name: Forest
item.notableAnimals: Fox, Deer, Boar, Wolf, Forest Wolf, Bear, Koala, Moon Cat, Moose
item.progressionUse: Early free area for stronger starter catches and night-only targets.
item.weatherOrSecretNote: Wolf uses Bone Bait; Forest Wolf and Moon Cat appear at night.

item.name: Jungle
item.progressionUse: Low-cost paid unlock that starts the Giraffe breeding route through Capybara.
item.weatherOrSecretNote: No weather-only note found in the biome guide.

item.name: Savanna
item.notableAnimals: Lion, Leopard, Zebra, Hippo, Kangaroo, Elephant
item.progressionUse: Second paid step with mounts and Elephant for the Toad breeding path.
item.weatherOrSecretNote: Roblox badge wording may map this area to Safari Island.

item.name: Desert
item.progressionUse: Early harder area for Basilisk hunting and desert-specific catches.
item.weatherOrSecretNote: Basilisk needs Sandstorm Totem support and a strong lasso.

item.name: Swamp
item.progressionUse: Breeding support area because Alligator is needed for Giraffe.
item.weatherOrSecretNote: No weather-only note found in the biome guide.

item.name: Snow Biome
item.notableAnimals: Arctic Fox, Penguin, Polar Bear, Yeti, Mammoth, Christmas Dragon, Festive Penguin
item.progressionUse: First hard-cost jump and the place to prepare for snow-weather farming.
item.weatherOrSecretNote: Yeti appears during Blizzard weather; Roblox badge wording may map this area to Ice Island.

item.name: Ocean
item.notableAnimals: Clownfish, Crab, Red Squid, Narwhal, Orca, Great White Shark, Octopus, Kraken
item.progressionUse: Water route for shark, Kraken, and later Forgotten Depths key context.
item.weatherOrSecretNote: Kraken appears during Tsunami weather; Great White Shark needs an Epic lasso.

item.name: Prehistoric Zone
item.progressionUse: Mid-game farming stop for high-BPS Epic value.
item.weatherOrSecretNote: The guide highlights Triceratops as a major Epic BPS target.

item.name: Mountain
item.progressionUse: Mythic breeding setup because Red Panda feeds Galaxy Kitsune and Galaxy Axolotl chains.
item.weatherOrSecretNote: No weather-only note found in the biome guide.

item.name: Underground
item.progressionUse: Mythic breeding setup because Axolotl is used in major late chains.
item.weatherOrSecretNote: Roblox badge wording may map this area to Cave Island.

item.name: Volcano / Volcano Core
item.notableAnimals: Fire Pup, Magma Dragon, Infernal Axolotl, Infernal Hydra
item.progressionUse: First million-cost route for Infernal pets and Volcanic mutation value.
item.weatherOrSecretNote: Roblox badge wording may map this area to Volcano Island.

item.name: Mystical Zone
item.progressionUse: Late breeding route because Kitsune connects into Galaxy Kitsune.
item.weatherOrSecretNote: No weather-only note found in the biome guide.

item.name: Sky Island
item.progressionUse: High-value route for Celestial Griffin and Celestial Hydra preparation.
item.weatherOrSecretNote: Cosmic Griffin route benefits from Cosmic Shower weather; official badge confirms Sky Island discovery.

item.name: Dragon Island
item.progressionUse: Extreme-cost target for the Lightning Dragon used in Hydra breeding.
item.weatherOrSecretNote: The guide says this area was added in Update 15 and needs fast travel support.

item.name: Forgotten Depths
item.progressionUse: Most expensive listed unlock and the route for the key-and-shapes puzzle.
item.weatherOrSecretNote: Catch the Clownfish with the key, then collect five underwater shapes to open the Baby Monkey cage.

item.name: Void Realm
item.progressionUse: Secret route for Void Dragon once the portal location is known.
item.weatherOrSecretNote: The guide says the hidden portal location can change by update.
